reason: The README clearly describes a Cordis plugin that bridges session activity with a local agentmemory daemon, exposes memory recall and remember tools, and injects recalled memory into model context.

summaries.zh: 将会话活动同步到本地 agentmemory 服务，并为模型提供记忆检索、记忆保存和上下文注入能力。
summaries.en: Bridges session activity to a local agentmemory service and provides memory recall, memory storage, and context injection for models.

capabilities: Mirrors session lifecycle activity to a local agentmemory daemon over REST
Provides model tools for recalling and remembering durable memory
Injects project and optionally semantic memory into model requests
Reads a configured bearer secret and sends it to the daemon
Uses the host shell capability to execute curl for daemon communication
